standard_prerequisites.name: The reduction of the coherence of a pushforward to the coherence of the pushforwards of the structure sheaves of the integral subschemes through the associated points
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the start of the counted proof (source lines 1792-1794) as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the statement for an arbitrary coherent module to the case of the structure sheaf of an integral closed subscheme.

standard_prerequisites.name: The finiteness of the normalization in a residue field over a Nagata scheme, and the Hartogs type criterion for coherence of a pushforward from a depth condition
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1795-1800 and 1816-1818) as cross-chapter pointers
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a coherent module in which the pushforward of the structure sheaf embeds, and then finishes once the depth condition at the complement is verified.

core_obligations: Reduce to a structure sheaf: by the criterion through the associated points it suffices to show the coherence of the pushforward of the structure sheaf of the integral subscheme through an associated point (proof lines 1792-1794)

Embed into a finite pushforward: the normalization of the scheme in the residue field of that point is finite, so its pushforward is coherent, isomorphisms compare the relevant opens and the resulting canonical map from the structure sheaf of the integral subscheme into that coherent module is injective (proof lines 1795-1813)

Verify the depth condition: it suffices to know that the depth of the coherent module at the points of the complement is at least two, which reduces by the finite morphism to the depth of the local rings of the normalization, and that depth is at least two because otherwise the dimension formula would contradict the assumption on the dimensions of the localisations through the associated point (proof lines 1816-1832)
Conclude: the Hartogs type criterion applies to the natural map and gives the coherence of the pushforward (proof lines 1816-1822)
proof_roadmap: 由关联点判据化归到 j_*i_{x,*}O_{W_x} 的凝聚性。令 π : Y → X 为 X 在 Spec κ(x) 中的正规化，π 有限，故 G = π_*O_Y 凝聚；且 i_{x,*}O_{W_x} → G|_U 单射，于是只需证 j_*(G|_U) 凝聚。
对 G → j_*(G|_U) 用 Hartogs 型深度判据：只需 z ∈ Z 处 depth(G_z) ≥ 2。取 z 上方的点 y_1,…,y_n，由跨章引理化归为 depth(O_{Y,y_i}) ≥ 2；否则由正规性判据 dim(O_{Y,y_i}) = 1，与维数公式及假设 (3) 矛盾。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement proves the coherence of the pushforward of a coherent module from an open subscheme of a locally Noetherian scheme, under the hypotheses that the scheme is Nagata and universally catenary and that the localisations of the closures of the associated points at the points of the complement have dimension at least two (author lemma at source lines 1775-1789, label lemma-finiteness-pushforward). The proof (source lines 1791-1833) reduces to the structure sheaf of an integral subscheme through an associated point using the criterion of this chapter, embeds its pushforward into the pushforward of a coherent module obtained from the normalization in the residue field, and verifies the depth condition required by the Hartogs type criterion: a failure of depth two would force a local ring of the normalization to have dimension one, contradicting the dimension formula and the hypothesis (proof lines 1816-1832). The embedding into the finite pushforward and the depth verification are the content. H3.
